answer: Here is one concrete wall: Starknet account deployment proof. It works because an account deployed at an early block, and the comet it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own an account deployed at an early block, and the mirror grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the tundra is that the farm's unit economics never work.
